correctness.rationale: The stationary rank inversion in arXiv:2308.06118v1 eq. (17) and edge jump eq. (21) reconstruct the entire normalized signed quantile including shocks. For any two speed ratios, the higher-speed/lower-speed quantile ratio is strictly increasing before the first plateau because atanh(u)/u is strictly increasing. Applying a monotone-likelihood covariance identity to squared quantiles proves strict increases of all standardized even moments. A beta-integral moment generating function yields the explicitly displayed second- and fourth-moment polynomials. The fourth cumulant simplifies exactly to pi^4 t^4/120-t^2-2t/3-2/15, with exactly one positive root by signs. Direct symbolic and finite numerical tests passed from the actual included verify.py path. Finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

The later 2025 same-author study treats new trapped and nonreciprocal models and does not state this claim. Actual published-finding corpus and primary literature comparisons found no same-object covering theorem. The general star-order comparison argument is classical and not claimed original.
